quiz.question_pt: Completa: It's essential that he ___ there.

options: I ask that he doesn't call
I ask that he not call
I ask that he don't call
I ask that he not calls
quiz.question_pt: ¿Cómo se dice 'Pido que él no llame'?

data_es.tip_pt: Después de suggest, insist, demand o it's essential that, usa la forma base: sin -s y sin to. En negativa: not + verbo.

items.pt: Ella insistió en que él se quedara

data_es.summary_pt: Después de verbos y expresiones de sugerencia o exigencia, se usa el verbo en su forma base.
data_es.cover_prompt: A cute hand-drawn scene of a wise owl in a suit gently pointing forward, giving advice to a small fox, soft pastel colors, no text or letters

common_mistake.right: I suggest that he go to the doctor.
common_mistake.wrong: I suggest him to go to the doctor.
common_mistake.why_pt: Suggest no admite objeto + to: usa that + forma base.
